triples.tail_surface: Fit the sunk key in the shaft and lead the impeller towards the shoulder of the shaft. Secure the impeller with washers (7 and 8) and a set screw.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装平键并将叶轮推至轴肩，用垫圈和紧定螺钉固定叶轮
triples.evidence_text: Fit the sunk key in the shaft and lead the impeller towards the shoulder of the shaft. Secure the impeller with washers (7 and 8) and a set screw.

triples.tail_surface: Take care that the ring at the end of the shaft seal spring locates in the recess of the impeller.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确保轴封弹簧端部的环位于叶轮凹槽内
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: Take care that the ring at the end of the shaft seal spring locates in the recess of the impeller.

triples.tail_surface: Place the O-ring (21) between pump casing and rear cover on the rear cover where it can be held with a little grease.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 将O型圈(21)置于泵壳与后盖之间并用少量润滑脂固定在后盖上
triples.evidence_text: Place the O-ring (21) between pump casing and rear cover on the rear cover where it can be held with a little grease.
